title: ID0421857-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000695]charger is out of order
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The charger is out of order because of the transformator 230V 24V which is out of order as you can see in the photos. Can you send the ticket to the french team please and to ANTOINE BRUA who knows the problem so that they can plan an intervention quickly please ?
